critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_request awaits ai_service.classify_drug on every POST /requests — adds ~1-2s Claude call latency to each request. Consider caching by (name.lower(), form.lower()) in Mongo to short-circuit repeats and reduce cost.
ai_service.classify_drug uses a fixed session_id='classify' for all classification calls — fine functionally but breaks per-user tracing; consider a random session per call.
_patient_view only strips schedule/fridge/specialty — good; but seed.py still writes these on 3 seeded requests, so pharmacies see them and patients don't (correct outcome).
AIChat SESSION_ID still generated once per module load (carry-over from iter 4); anonymous users in one tab share it.

server.py post_update endpoint accepts arbitrary strings for `field` — no whitelist/length cap; could be abused to inflate the $0.50 earning entries. Recommend bounding to ['Dose','Form','Quantity','Substitution','Stock status','Ready time'] or maxlen 40.
